name: Gravity Screen Flip
description: Rotates the gameplay view 180 degrees whenever gravity is reversed.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Rotate the gameplay view when gravity is reversed.

duration.name: Rotation Duration
duration.description: How long the rotation takes, in seconds. Set to 0 for an instant flip.

continuous-spin.name: Keep Spinning Same Direction
continuous-spin.description: Every gravity change rotates a further 180 degrees instead of rotating back and forth.
